slides.title: Your life insurance might [[retire]] the same day you do.
Many people's only life insurance comes through [[work]].
slides.body: Group term coverage usually ends when employment ends.

slides.title: That can include coverage on a [[spouse]].
The survivor's expenses don't drop by [[half]].
slides.body: If one spouse passes, a pension, annuity income, or one Social Security check may stop.

slides.title: Some group plans let you [[convert]] or carry coverage.
slides.body: The cost and terms vary, so compare them before you leave.

slides.title: Options to price:
items: A new individual term or permanent policy
Using other assets to cover the gap
slides.body: Each has costs, underwriting, and tradeoffs.

slides.title: Ask before you retire:
items: What would it cost to replace?

slides.title:
Retirement plans cover income.
Make sure yours covers the [[survivor]] too.
slides.footnote: Educational only. Savvy Financial and its affiliates do not provide tax advice. Guarantees are based on the claims-paying ability of the issuing insurance company.
